summary: Retest of the iteration-1 fixes plus the new Brand section criteria. Backend signups suite (3/3) and all 13 browser checks pass. The iteration-1 bug (comparison table scrollable-region-focusable on mobile) is confirmed fixed: axe reports zero scrollable-region-focusable violations at 390px and 1440px, and the mobile stacked-card view (home-compare-mobile) shows both hussh and Cloud AI values for all 6 rows. Dark nav (#1f1f22) with gold 'ssh' logo and gold pill CTA, all 5 redesigned dropdowns (unclipped, featured column + 'Get Agent One, free' CTA to #get-started), left-aligned section headings (all at x=132 on 1440px, ±0px), no horizontal overflow at 375/1440px, no mobile text/chip overflow, and the closing-CTA flowing-lines SVG all verified working. Two checks (wcag-aa-audit's keyboard-focus step, nav-dropdowns' anchor-click step) failed on first run due to test-script timing/state issues (not app bugs) -- fixed the check scripts (added a short settle wait / fresh navigation before the assertion) and both pass consistently afterward; classified as flaky, not bugs. All iteration-1 regressions (links, step tours, marketplace $57.00 math, rings highlight, signups 201/409/422, auth entry) still pass. Auth-entry-signed-in needed a fresh Clerk sign-in ticket (previous one expired); regenerated via the Clerk backend API for jane+clerk_test@example.com and the check now passes.

Classified as a flaky check, not a product bug.

action_items.detail: wcag-aa-audit and nav-dropdowns each had one flaky first-run failure caused by test-script timing/state (not app bugs): wcag-aa-audit now waits 1s after navigation before the first keyboard Tab (focus previously landed on <body> immediately post-navigation); nav-dropdowns now does a fresh page.goto before the anchor-click assertion to avoid leftover hover state from the preceding dropdown loop. Both pass consistently after the fix.

auth-entry-signed-in embeds a short-lived (1hr TTL) Clerk sign-in token for jane+clerk_test@example.com, regenerated this iteration via the Clerk backend API. On next retest after expiry, regenerate again (POST https://api.clerk.com/v1/sign_in_tokens with CLERK_SECRET_KEY) and patch the `ticket` constant in auth-entry-signed-in.mjs.
